title: Penthouse July 1984 Pet of the Year Play-Off Buckley Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Front cover has scattered white specks/scuffs, mostly on the left (see photo 1). Back cover clean. Spine intact.
description:
Penthouse magazine, July 1984 - Special Issue Pet of the Year Play-Off. Original $3.00 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: William F. Buckley on Jesse Jackson; Staying power - winning a 6-day marathon; James Beard on barbecuing; Herb Gold on love; the continuing whitewash of Klaus Barbie.

Back cover: Lucky Strike filters cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
